measurement: explicit accessibility click listeners: native re-measurement
result: FIXED AND MEASURED. With explicit accessibility Click listeners on both panel buttons, one accessibility invoke on support-preview-button produced the full in-process sequence - action=reached, build=started, build=finished, install=accepted - and the preview element appeared in the automation tree (support-preview-readonly present, 59 descendants in the dump, five support* ids). Before the change the same invoke produced zero trace lines in five attempts.
cause: MEASURED: adding an explicit accessibility Click listener makes the handler run. NOT measured: whether the synthesised press was ever generated for the earlier attempts, or was generated and then missed in the hit test - gpui's internal node bounds at dispatch time were never inspected. The only proven statement is that removing the dependency on a synthetic press removes the failure.
scope: Both panel buttons got the same explicit listener so neither is treated specially; mouse and keyboard paths are unchanged, as are generation, the state machine, saving, redaction and permissions.
